reviews.author: Ilyas A
reviews.comment: We spent little over a week for our honeymoon at salt of palmar - although upon arrival checkin was little less than what we imagined the team made up for it with their attentive service and helpfulness - the quality of the food is one of the most unique points of the hotel - locally sourced organic ingredients used for high quality fresh meals. The management team are so alert and friendly and tended to our every need they always made it a point to think of solutions pragmatically - I want to especially thank Rishi for being very professional and helpful in helping with making up for the checkin hassle we faced - the hotel went really above and beyond for us! And we really felt the genuine care a special thanks to Sanjay who always had a smile and made us feel like we were getting extra care! Very funny and welcoming guy! The hotel also offered us a discounted couples spa treatment I have to admit Juliana was really good with the firm massage to get through my knots and put me to sleep! We’re so glad we decided to come to Mauritius in comparison to the other Indian Ocean islands - the Mauritian people were really warm hearted and kind to us everywhere we went.Read more

reviews.author: Keatfarm
reviews.comment: My wife and I came to Salt for a week to switch off from every day life and to enjoy a relaxing holiday, something we very rarely do. The hotel had some incredible reviews and also ticked a lot of boxes for us and boy it didn't disappoint once we were there. From the moment we walked through the door, a sense of calm came over us, which lasted for our whole stay. The design of this Hotel is beautiful, which is only complemented by the wonderful, friendly and knowledgeable team, who are just incredible. And the food is phenomenal! The whole team always gave us 100% and made us feel very calm and relaxed. They even went the extra mile for us when we had difficulties with our return flight. If Mauritius is on your radar, please make this your No 1 place to stay.Read more

reviews.author: kcabsolutely1965
reviews.comment: Where to start? First impressions: a grand looking entrance greets you along with staff greeting you with a hand on heart bowed welcome, your first encounter on how lovely all the staff are going to be during your visit. As you step through the door, you can see that pretty much 'every' aspect & item has been designed to be 'Instagramable'... you WILL photograph everything during your stay!!! The place is stunning. Rooms: We chose beachfront rooms and were not disappointed with the views. Huge 'very open' walk-in showers are a nice touch, quirky colours and touches throughout the room with big comfortable bed & pillows. Food & Bar: We were intrigued how the 'All Inclusive' option works as SALT have no buffet, everything including breakfast you order individually from a menu, the idea being no waste. This actually works very well although a 9-day stay exhausts most choices & suggest taking advantage of the daily specials throughout your stay at lunch & dinner. Service is interesting, as mentioned the staff are all fantastic & loveable but our experience found that many of our orders would be lost in translation somewhere between us, the waiter, the chef, the bar, no great mishaps just 'quirky' liveable/ rectifiable ones that weirdly just added to the whole charm of the place... like it wasn't really trying to be 5 star perfect but being that cool boutiquey place you just chill in. Beach: White sands, plenty of beds with  beautiful views & towels aplenty. Boat House with again nice friendly helpful staff for your water sport needs, highly recommend the free daily boat trip out to Snorkel in the coral. Pool & Roof Bar: Take a look at the photos... picture perfect. Spa: We all enjoyed a 60 minute treatment each designed to our individual needs, the experience ends with a relaxing chill in their SALT room, salt crystal floor, illuminated colour changing solid salt brick work surrounds you. Negatives: Not really. Personally I would suggest that both the food menu & bar menu financially doesn't need so many * items (i.e not included in all-inclusive)  e.g being a small or large draft lager is included but a small draft ale/beer is not? Positives: Stunning modern design with loveable staff making your stay a very enjoyable one!!Thank you.Read more

reviews.author: chloe floyd
reviews.comment: My partner and I come to Mauritius every year to visit his family and always love to try new hotels along the way!!!I can say that we received the utmost amazing service from ALL staff and nothing was ever too much for them! They were so kind caring and also very fun to talk to and laugh with making me feel so comfortable along with my partner throughout our stay! We definitely will be back! Here are a few names from the most amazing staff here that deserve the most recognition! - Dervin- Sanjay- Rewa- Fayaaz- Rajiv - Shib - Bhavish- Ved- Vish- Med - Raju From working in the hospitality industry myself it’s a hardworking and stressful job! We’re  so proud of you all and thank you so much for everything you do! Keep up the hard work you are all doing amazing! ❤️Read more

reviews.author: Kirsty D
reviews.comment: Staff were very welcoming, attentive and friendly. We had breakfast during our stay and the occasional dinner, the food was a delicious blend of local cuisine, expertly cooked and presented. Most nights had a theme, which was fun, and there were great vegan/veggie options too. A shout out to our favourite waiter, Sanjay, for looking after us during our trip. Our hotel room was nice, no ocean view unfortunately, a bit noisy at times, and a warning about no tv or shower curtain/door! The hotel was intimate and cosy with a lovely pool which captured the sun most of the day, but the show stopper for us was the beach. Crystal blue water, hardly any waves and beautiful coral & sealife to snorkel and discover. The hotel offered complimentary snorkelling and glass bottom boat trips, which we took advantage of, as well as free kayak, SUP and pedalo’s to rent. A nice surprise was the hotel’s itinerary of activities ranging from the usual volleyball and yoga to bath fizz making and cocktail classes. A very nice touch and a great way to meet fellow guests.Read more

reviews.author: GUY D
reviews.comment: Our 3rd visit in two years.We have travelled the globe and not received an experience as Salt of Palmar, Mauritius.From Raj and Rishi who make things work 24/7  are on site daily,With staff as Med, Vish and so many more will make your stay a memory to never forget.The service, staff, rooms, food especially, the paradise view when you arrive.We are already looking to come back as we we have made Salt of Palmar our home in Mauritius.Huge thanks to absolutely every staff member.We will see you all again very soon.Regards Guy and Anne DoddsRead more

reviews.author: Guy D
reviews.comment: Our 3rd trip in two years.We have travelled the globe and for service, staff, rooms and absolutely everything about Salt of Palmar is fabulous and way beyond our experience elsewhere.Raj and Rishi run the show but are always are on site to assist and keep the wheels turning 24/7.Staff members are too many to mention.As you walk through the front door you are looking at paradise.So.. we are now looking to book our 4th trip.Huge thanks to everyone at Salt, our home in Mauritius Guy Dodds and Anne GoddardRead more

reviews.author: kulvinderbahra
reviews.comment: This hotel was booked within 2 months of travel, through Trailfinders. I was excited to go for a restful break, and thought it would serve this purpose. The hotel has a concept, a homely feel without a reception desk. In its place is a gift shop, a library room and an open sitting foyer. The hotel is comfortable, clean and the staff are attentive when you get their attention. There are a lot of staff in the restaurant and bar. The restaurant staff Med, Vineet, Anshika, Prince and Vishram the chef I met were very hospitable, and the food is wholesome, with good sized portions. Sometimes I asked to pack the food, and it was never a problem - too much to eat, and I didn’t want to waste. The absence of the reception meant you had to hover around waiting for someone to appear to help with your query. Contacting them through their phone app was their preferred way of comms, not ideal if you’re looking for a digital detox! I paid half board, and saw that nearly half the dishes are excluded, and if I wanted to order, especially fish or seafood, it’s at a 25% discount. The price of drinks and coconut water was extortionate. It is a very expensive hotel to stay at, for the amenities you don’t get. The bar staff either chose to give crisps with your drinks or not. I asked, so I received. No tablet in the room as advertised to watch netflix. No mini fridge to keep drinks or fruit/food cool, but I did request one. No iron, or ironing board until requested. Rubber flip flops would be useful in bedrooms, rather than the room slippers. The sea at the hotel has rocks, and is windy, so water activities are more difficult, although included in the price you pay. Walk to the right, and have water shoes with you, and you’ll enjoy the endless soft sanded beaches and views. They charge 15% tax on the cost of all items booked through the hotel, and they take a flat amount on credit card of 14000 Mauritian rupees. I had underspent, and I was told I would need to spend up to the amount or I wouldn’t receive a refund. I tried to pay the amount owed in cash - euros and rupees, I was told this couldn’t be accepted, as the euros would be charged with commission on top of the 15% I’d already paid. So I bought a coffee and a snack to meet the 14000 amount to pay with my credit card. All in all, a safe happy memorable trip, with verbal feedback given to the concierge to improve the reception experience on arrival if a guest arrives in the morning and the room will be available at 2pm.Read more

reviews.author: mike_piercy
reviews.comment: As so many reviewers have said: the hotel is lovely, the food is fantastic and the customer service is excellent.However two things really annoyed me and would stop me going back. Firstly the cost of drinks is outrageous. A draft beer costs over £10 and the cheapest bottle of wine is over £50 - for a bottle I could buy in our supermarket for £9.Secondly the food plans are very restrictive. We chose the Full Board plan but found that nearly half the items on the menu are excluded from the plan. Nearly all the seafood dishes are excluded. I would not mind so much if you could buy the excluded items for a small supplement, but no you have to pay the full price less 25%. The whole point of a food plan is that you can budget for your holiday and not have to watch costs building up during your stay.Read more

reviews.author: Oliver B
reviews.comment: This is without doubt one of the best hotels we have stayed in to date. This "boutique" hotel is created on the basis that it is a high-quality restaurant managed by Chef Shiva & his team. The attention to your stay is never too much for any of the pleasant staff.We enjoyed every element of our stay, enough to do with trips outside the hotel, and as we wanted to have a relaxing holiday, staying in the hotel around the exclusive pool and beach was great.This hotel should get the recognition and plaudits it and the team deserve.To mention just a few - Shiva, Visham, Sanjay, Shib, Vish, Rajiv, Raju, and of course Vikishrama.Read more
